output.question: Has T-Mobile announced layoffs?
output.answer: Yes. As reported on August 26, 2026, T-Mobile disclosed 77 job cuts across Washington, with departures scheduled between September 21 and November 18, 2026. That included 63 newly disclosed cuts and 14 previously announced departures that had been deferred. T-Mobile also confirmed layoffs in its IT organization on March 27, 2026, without disclosing how many employees were affected.

key_facts.fact: As reported August 26, 2026, T-Mobile disclosed 77 Washington job cuts, scheduled for September 21–November 18, 2026.
The August 26, 2026 report identified 63 newly disclosed cuts and 14 previously announced departures deferred until the fall.
T-Mobile confirmed IT layoffs on March 27, 2026, but did not verify the number affected.
